title: $0 mesh response row
description: One row per $0-mesh model invocation. Appended by a SINGLE writer to state/ssot/dollar_zero_mesh_responses.jsonl. An unvalidated model output is not evidence and must not become a row without status=schema_fail.

ts_utc.description: Observed clock at write. NOT hand-authored.

on_behalf_of.description: REQUIRED. A rostered carrier owns this job. Per free_mesh_harness.contract.md, the mesh never acts on its own behalf.

role.description: ROLE, never a callsign. Mesh workers do not hold callsigns.

param_count_b.description: Billions of parameters. Rows with param_count_b < 8 and role != 'summarizer' MUST carry status=tier_violation — see the 3B rule in cost_tier_routing.v0_1.md.

budget_usd.description: MUST be exactly 0. A nonzero value is a routing bug, not a cost.

status.description: schema_fail is a FIRST-CLASS outcome and must be written, not silently retried. A mesh whose failures are invisible reads green forever.

response_text.description: Raw model output, verbatim, including on schema_fail. This is the only forensic record.

parsed_payload.description: Validated structured output. MUST be absent unless schema_valid is true.

validator.description: e.g. pydantic-ai 1.70.0 / instructor 1.14.5. Which program did the validating - never the model itself.

verifier_result.description: How this row was checked, by what program. Absent or empty means claim_status may not be wired_with_receipts.

prev_sha256.description: Prior row_sha256, or null ONLY on a genesis or explicitly-noted re-anchor row.

prev_sha256_note.description: REQUIRED when prev_sha256 is null on a non-genesis row. Explains why no link is computable.

hash_rule.description: The EXACT canonicalization used, stated on the row. A hash nobody can recompute is self-declared, not tamper-evident. See L_UNREPRODUCIBLE_ROW_HASH and L_CHAIN_HASH_ABANDONED_SILENTLY.

sealed.description: No HMAC/Ed25519 key exists in-forge at gen-133. SENTINEL-CLASS, not blood-class.
